title: Night Prayer Before Going To Bed | Lay It Down And Rest In God's Peace
description:
A night prayer before going to bed. Lay the day down, cast your cares on God, and rest.

Ten minutes of Scripture and prayer for the end of the day: put down the weight, the anger and the fear, and sleep knowing he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

"I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety." Psalm 4:8 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Psalm 127:2, 1 Peter 5:7, Matthew 11:28-30, Ephesians 4:26, 1 John 1:9, Psalm 121:3-4, Psalm 139:11-12, Isaiah 26:3, Psalm 63:6, Psalm 4:8, Proverbs 3:24.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
